'''C. S. Yogananda '''is a mathematician and Professor of Mathematics at the J.S.S Science and Technology University in Mysore, India.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://jssstuniv.in/k-Teacher/dr-c-s-yogananda/ |title=Dr. C S Yogananda – JSS S&T University |website=Jssstuniv.in |date= |accessdate=2024-09-03 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200213075052/http://jssstuniv.in/k-Teacher/dr-c-s-yogananda/ |archive-date=2020-02-13}}</ref> He is the founder of Sriranga Digital Software Technologies<ref name="auto"/> and author<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ias.ac.in/listing/bibliography/reso/C._S._Yogananda |title=Resonance – Journal of Science Education &#124; Indian Academy of Sciences |publisher=Ias.ac.in |date= |accessdate=2019-11-10}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.currentscience.ac.in/search.php |at=Search for Yogananda |title=Search results |website=currentscience.ac.in }}</ref> who has published several writings on mathematics.

==Education==
Yogananda received his Ph.D. from the [[Institute of Mathematical Sciences, Chennai]] under advisor [[Ramachandran Balasubramanian]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=C S Yogananda - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=251282 |access-date=2024-03-10 |website=www.mathgenealogy.org}}</ref><ref>Ramachandran, R. (August 1991). ""[https://www.imsc.res.in/annrep/Archive/AR1991.pdf#page=36 AR1991.pdf]"". The Institute of Mathematical Sciences. [https://web.archive.org/web/20240423173709/https://www.imsc.res.in/annrep/Archive/AR1991.pdf#page=36 Archived] from the original on 23 April 2024. Retrieved 23 April 2024.</ref>

== Mathematical Olympiads ==
Yogananda has been involved with the Mathematical Olympiad movement in India since 1989. He has participated as a resource person and evaluated answer books for various regional (RMO) and national (INMO) Olympiads.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.imo-official.org/ |title=International Mathematical Olympiad |publisher=Imo-official.org |date= |accessdate=2019-11-10}}</ref> He was also an academic coordinator for the Problem Coordinators workshops organized by the National Board for Higher Mathematics. He was a member of the Core Faculty at the [[International Mathematical Olympiad|International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO)Training Camps]] and was also involved in the selection of the Indian Team since 1989. Yogananda was a member of the Organizing Committee (Computer Committee/Publications Committee/Problem Selection Committee) when India hosted the IMO in July 1996 in [[Mumbai]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.imo-official.org/country_info.aspx?code=IND |title=International Mathematical Olympiad |publisher=Imo-official.org |date= |accessdate=2019-11-10}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |doi=10.1007/BF02835176 |title=The 37th International Mathematical Olympiad |date=1996 |last1=Yogananda |first1=C. S. |last2=Krishnan |first2=T. |journal=Resonance |volume=1 |issue=5 |pages=92–94 }}</ref> Yogananda was an Observer and Deputy Leader for the Indian team participating in the IMO in the years 1993,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.imo-official.org/team_r.aspx?code=IND&year=1993 |title=International Mathematical Olympiad |publisher=Imo-official.org |date= |accessdate=2019-11-10}}</ref> 1995,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.imo-official.org/team_r.aspx?code=IND&year=1995 |title=International Mathematical Olympiad |publisher=Imo-official.org |date= |accessdate=2019-11-10}}</ref> and 1998.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.imo-official.org/team_r.aspx?code=IND&year=1998 |title=International Mathematical Olympiad |publisher=Imo-official.org |date= |accessdate=2019-11-10}}</ref> During this time, India won 3 Gold, 10 Silver and 4 Bronze medals in total.

== Sriranga Digital Software Technologies==
Yogananda established Sriranga Digital Software Technologies in 2003, with the primary intention of bringing digital technologies to the service of Indian languages.<ref name="auto">{{Cite web|url=https://sriranga.digital/|title=Home &#124; Sriranga Digital Software Technologies|website=sriranga.digital}}</ref>

== Advaita Sharada ==
Yogananda also created a digital archive of [[Sri Shankaracharya]]'s works.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://advaitasharada.sringeri.net/%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%B0%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%A5%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%83/ |title=ग्रन्थाः &#124; अद्वैतशारदा &#124; दक्षिणाम्नाय श्रीशारदापीठम्, शृङ्गेरी |publisher=Advaitasharada.sringeri.net |date= |accessdate=2019-11-10}}</ref> The Advaita Sharada initiative has been recognized by the Jagadgurus of Sri Sringeri Sharada Peetham.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sringeri.net/ |title=Sringeri Sharada Peetham - Jagadguru Shankaracharya Maha Samsthanam, Sringeri |publisher=Sringeri.net |date= |accessdate=2019-11-10}}</ref> The archive is a collection of Prasthanatraya Bhashya of Sri Shankara, his {{Transliteration|gu|prakarana granthas}} and also the commentaries by later commentators of Sri Shankara. The archive can help in understanding the works of Sri Shankara in more depth since it allows a complete search of the texts. <!-- Same with this paragraph. Some information should be elaborated on. --> {{citation needed|date=January 2021}}

== Honorary positions ==
{{BLP unreferenced section|date=January 2021}}
* Honorary Secretary, Leelavati Trust (Regd.), Bangalore.
* Honorary Joint Director, Jawaharlal Nehru Planetarium, Bangalore from November 1, 2000, to October 31, 2003.
* Member Secretary, Steering Committee for Informatics Olympiad.
* Chairman, TeX Users Group India (TUGIndia).
